changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/5876-one-lookup-predicate.md`

- names `recordFields.tsx` → `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/recordFields.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `computeLookupExpand` in `ObjectDataTable.tsx` carried its own `isLookup`, byte-identical to the exported `isLookupType` in `recordFields.tsx` after objectui#5692 pointed both at `@object-ui/core`'s `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES`. Nothing kept them aligned: a future edit to either — a member added, the retirement gate moved — would have re-forked the `$expand` decision from the predicate whose docblock claims to drive it. `computeLookupExpand` now calls `isLookupType`, which gains its first production consumer, and the module no longer imports the shared family or the retirement gate at all.

### `.changeset/6874-retire-titleformat.md`

- names `plugin-dashboard/src/recordFields.tsx` → `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/recordFields.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `plugin-dashboard/src/recordFields.tsx` had already recorded this exact measurement as its reason for not copying the key into that seam, so it was a measured no-op in two seams and retired from only one. Same defect class as objectui#6625 (`FieldMeta.decimals`), objectui#6597 (`FieldMeta.referenceTo`) and objectui#6711 (`reference_to_field`), and the same disposition as objectui#6711 on this very list.

### `.changeset/dashboard-expandable-family-convergence-5692.md`

- names `recordFields.tsx` → `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/recordFields.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `plugin-dashboard`'s two private copies of the reference-bearing field family now read `@object-ui/core`'s published `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` instead of restating it — `LOOKUP_TYPES` in `recordFields.tsx` and the inline disjunction inside `computeLookupExpand` in `ObjectDataTable.tsx`. Both carry the identity pin the already-converged consumers carry, so a member-identical private copy fails rather than quietly re-forking the table.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `1dbb9933c` (merge-base with origin/main): 3 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1296 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1865 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36037789705)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a688648bcbd255ce6eec77bd230818b1dbb49e92`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (90 of 90 at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Gate is correct for every type that reaches `renderFieldValue`.** Two callers only (`ObjectDataTable.enrich()` at `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx:886`, `RecordDetailDrawer` at `:126`); both build the meta through `buildFieldMeta`, which writes `type: overrides.type ?? meta?.type` (`recordFields.tsx:355`). For an object-field column `meta` is the bound object schema's field def (`fieldsByName[col.accessorKey]`); for an authored `TableColumn` the override is `authored.type` (widened `string`, read from `TableColumn.type`, whose published union `TABLE_COLUMN_TYPES` carries both `'date'` and `'datetime'`). The drawer passes no overrides, so its type is always the schema's. The spec `FieldType` vocabulary (objectstack `2c1011b`, closed enum) has exactly three temporal members — `date`, `datetime`, `time` — and `@object-ui/fields` maps `time` to `TextCellRenderer`, so `DATE_PATTERN_FIELD_TYPES = {date, datetime}` is the whole set of date cells. No alias spelling (`Date`, `DateTime`, `timestamp`) exists as a producer in either repo (grep of objectui `apps`/`examples`/`packages` non-test and objectstack `examples`/`platform-objects`: zero).
- **Census "no non-date type relies on the branch" — TRUE, and the fix repairs more real producers than the report listed.** objectui head, both `format: '…'` and JSON `"format": "…"` spellings, over `packages` `apps` `examples` `content` `docs` `skills`: the only date-letter `format` keys on non-date types are `content/docs/fields/auto-number.mdx` (autonumber patterns), `content/docs/fields/time.mdx:38` (`time` + `'HH:mm'`) and `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-auto-number/date-based-ticket-id.json:13` (`auto_number` + `"TKT-{YYYY}{MM}-{0000}"`). All three were em-dash collisions before and paint their stored value now; none relied on the date branch. The PR's census named only `auto-number.mdx`, so it under-counted in the fix's favour. `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:674` is `type: date`; `packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts:337` is a comment. `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md:624` (`close_date` + `"YYYY-MM-DD"`, no `type`) sits in a widget with `"objectName": "opportunity"` under the README's own sentence "You don't need to declare `type` on each column. The widget fetches the object schema", so its type is the schema's `date` — still date-formatted. objectstack at `2c1011b`: `examples/**` holds 19 `format` keys — dataset measures (`0,0`, `0.0`, `0.0%`), widget `options.format: 'currency'`, one cube measure, one `type: 'format'` validation rule (`account.object.ts:161`, a rule, not a field) — zero on object fields; `platform-objects` hits are `resultDialog` fields (`secret`, `code-list`), not object fields; zero `returnType: 'date'` formulas outside spec/lint tests; the 28 non-test `packages/**` date-letter hits are unrelated keys (esbuild `format: 'esm'`, PEM, lint prose). **No real producer regresses.**
- **`time` renders correctly.** `getCellRenderer('time')` → `TextCellRenderer` → paints `14:30`; pinned by the fifth case. (Side note, no impact: the test spells `type: 'autonumber'` as the spec does while the registry key is `auto_number`; both fall to `TextCellRenderer`.)
- **9909 fixture change is a declaration fix.** `FieldMeta` is not on the published surface (`src/index.tsx` re-exports nothing from `recordFields`; `package.json` `exports` publishes only `"."`), so a type-less `FieldMeta` literal is not something an author can write. The authored analogue — a type-less `TableColumn` with a date-letter `format` on a key the object schema does not carry — is the trade-off the changeset declares and the eighth case pins (`overrides: { type: 'date' }`). The "4 red of 12 without the key" figure is consistent with 3 surfaces × 4 `it.each` cases.
- **Changeset `.changeset/10220-format-hint-not-date-pattern.md` — every sentence TRUE against the code.** Two render paths (both callers); `object-data-table` is the widget spelling (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:143`); `formatDate` returns an em dash for an unparsable value with no error (`date-display.ts:290-293`); node probe from the scratch directory: `new Date('14:30')`, `new Date('ORD-20240315-01')`, `new Date('ada@example.com')` are all Invalid, `new Date(1234.5)` paints `Jan 1, 1970`; `/[YMDHms]/` matches `email` and `money` (and not `relative`, `date`, `phone`, `url`); `resolveCellRendererType` maps `email` → `EmailCellRenderer` (`mailto:` anchor); the currency and percent branches are untouched in the diff; the type-less column trade-off is stated with its remedy.
- **Changed comments/docblocks TRUE.** The `DATE_PATTERN_FIELD_TYPES` docblock and the test header paraphrase the `FieldSchema.format` description objectstack#19763 wrote (merged 2026-09-23, present in the checkout as `041c8cf`): the actual text says the `date`/`datetime` cells read it "as a display STYLE" and a plain-text field's "shared cell-renderer resolver reads a small set of words that promote the cell to a richer renderer" — matches. The second commit's claim that the spec release this repo builds against (the lockfile-pinned `@objectstack/spec`) still ships the older one-line description was verified from the published npm tarball: `describe('Format string (e.g. email, phone)')`. The inline comment about `relative` falling through is TRUE (no date letter). Test docblock's "PARSED as an epoch timestamp" TRUE (`toDisplayDate` does `new Date(value)` on a number).
- **Pending changesets stay true.** The three that name `recordFields.tsx` literally (`5876-one-lookup-predicate`, `6874-retire-titleformat`, `dashboard-expandable-family-convergence-5692`) concern `isLookupType`, `titleFormat` and `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES`, none touched. Two more mention `recordFields` without the extension: `6694-dashboard-lookup-reference-meta` (render chain through `getCellRenderer` and "FieldMeta is internal" — both still true) and `7178-format-measure-date` ("`recordFields` already routed a date-shaped `format` into the same style slot" — still true for date/datetime fields).
- **Published docblock check — INCOMPLETE, not false ⇒ note.** `packages/types/src/data-display.ts:623-636`, `TableColumn.format`: "Field-meta override: display format pattern for the cell value (e.g. `"$0,0"`, `"0%"`, `"YYYY-MM-DD"`), honoured by `object-data-table`'s cell pipeline — `renderFieldValue`'s currency / percent / date branches — and by the numeric right-alignment inference. Documented as an author override by `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`'s README and exercised by its cells suite. The plain `data-table` renderer does not read it; its type-driven rendering is {@link TableColumn.type} / `cell`." Every clause remains literally true: the date branch still reads and honours this key on the column types the widget's documented model supplies (the fetched object schema, or `TableColumn.type`, declared on the same interface as "Data type for formatting"). The docstring never said the key alone selects the branch, and its sibling conditions (a numeric value for the currency and percent branches) were equally unstated before. The one reading now wrong — a type-less column on a key absent from the object schema — is the declared trade-off. The docstring is outside the claimed file surface; a one-clause follow-up ("on a `date` / `datetime` column") is owed but not same-PR. Not a FAIL.
- **Pins real and able to fail.** The new test imports `buildFieldMeta`/`renderFieldValue` from `../recordFields` with no mocks (grep: none), renders through the real function and asserts painted text. Deleting the `DATE_PATTERN_FIELD_TYPES.has(...)` line sends the five non-date cases back to `formatDate` — em dash, `Jan 1, 1970`, em dash, em dash, em dash — each contradicting its assertion, while the three controls pass either way: exactly the reported 5/3 split. CI test shards on the head are green.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` is appropriate. `recordFields` is not re-exported from `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx` and the `exports` map publishes only `"."`, so `renderFieldValue`, `buildFieldMeta`, `FieldMeta` and the new unexported `DATE_PATTERN_FIELD_TYPES` are all internal; no export moves. Behaviour changes only for non-date fields carrying a date-letter `format` (previously an em dash or a 1970 date, i.e. broken) and for the declared type-less-column edge; `date`/`datetime` fields render byte-identically (two controls). Not major.

- Check-runs on `a688648bcbd255ce6eec77bd230818b1dbb49e92` (polled; all complete at 2026-09-24T17:30Z): 43 total — 39 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)`, `dependabot`), 1 `failure`: `Spec Main Shape Gate` (run 36033544440, job 107747952162).

The same check on `main` at `8b1f06619` (this PR's merge-base) is also `failure` with the identical 20 annotations. Not PR-induced; anchored on objectui#10287.
- Local-checkout note: `FETCH_HEAD` in the shared `.git` was moved by another fetch mid-review; every tree read used for the judgments above was re-anchored on the explicit head sha.
